//@version=6
// ============================================================
//  QUANT PRIME · RESEARCH BUILD RES-3223
//  Prior Week + Volatility + Sessions + Pair Metrics
//  Prior week H/L/C, Volatility state meter, Session highlighter, Pair-by-pair metrics
//
//  Generated file. Do not edit.
//  Edit the source piece and regenerate.
//  quantprime.uk
// ============================================================
indicator("QP RES-3223 · Prior Week + Volatility + Sessions + Pair Metrics", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_labels_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500, max_bars_back = 500)

// ---------- STARTER ----------
st3_on   = input.bool(true,      "Show prior week H/L/C",        group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cHi  = input.color(#c9a84c,  "High",  inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cLo  = input.color(#00abff,  "Low",   inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")
st3_cCl  = input.color(#9aa0a6,  "Close", inline = "st3", group = "Starter · Prior week")

[st3_h, st3_l, st3_c] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "W", [high[1], low[1], close[1]], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

plot(st3_on ? st3_h : na, "PW High",  color = st3_cHi, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_l : na, "PW Low",   color = st3_cLo, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)
plot(st3_on ? st3_c : na, "PW Close", color = st3_cCl, style = plot.style_stepline, linewidth = 1)

// ---------- MAIN ----------
mn2_on    = input.bool(true, "Show volatility state",        group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_len   = input.int(14,    "ATR length",   minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_look  = input.int(500,   "Lookback",     minval = 50,    group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_lo    = input.int(30,    "Low below %",  minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_hi    = input.int(70,    "High above %", minval = 1,     group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_sz    = input.string("Tiny", "Volatility text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Main · Volatility state")
mn2_pos   = input.string("Top right", "Volatility table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Main · Volatility state")

mn2_atr   = ta.atr(mn2_len)
mn2_rank  = ta.percentrank(mn2_atr, mn2_look)
mn2_word  = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? "LOW" : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? "HIGH" : "NORMAL"
mn2_col   = mn2_rank < mn2_lo ? #9aa0a6 : mn2_rank > mn2_hi ? #c9a84c : #00abff

mn2_size  = mn2_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : mn2_sz == "Small" ? size.small : mn2_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large

mn2_where = mn2_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : mn2_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : mn2_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

var table mn2_tbl = table.new(mn2_where, 2, 2, border_width = 0)
if mn2_on and barstate.islast
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 0, "VOLATILITY", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 0, mn2_word,     text_color = mn2_col, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 0, 1, "PERCENTILE", text_color = #6b7280, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(mn2_tbl, 1, 1, str.tostring(mn2_rank, "#") + "%", text_color = #f2f0ea, text_size = mn2_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

// ---------- SIDE ----------
sd2_on   = input.bool(true, "Show sessions", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_s1   = input.session("0700-0900", "Session 1", inline = "sd2a", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_c1   = input.color(color.new(#c9a84c, 88), "", inline = "sd2a", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_s2   = input.session("1300-1400", "Session 2", inline = "sd2b", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_c2   = input.color(color.new(#00abff, 88), "", inline = "sd2b", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_s3   = input.session("1900-2000", "Session 3", inline = "sd2c", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_c3   = input.color(color.new(#9aa0a6, 90), "", inline = "sd2c", group = "Side · Sessions")
sd2_tz   = input.string("UTC", "Session timezone", group = "Side · Sessions")

sd2_in(sess) =>
    not na(time(timeframe.period, sess, sd2_tz))

bgcolor(sd2_on and sd2_in(sd2_s1) ? sd2_c1 : na, title = "Session 1")
bgcolor(sd2_on and sd2_in(sd2_s2) ? sd2_c2 : na, title = "Session 2")
bgcolor(sd2_on and sd2_in(sd2_s3) ? sd2_c3 : na, title = "Session 3")

// ---------- DESSERT ----------
ds3_on  = input.bool(true, "Show pair metrics", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics", tooltip = "Compares several markets side by side on the same day. Day and week show how far each has moved. ATR is a typical bar's range. Day size compares how wide today's high-to-low range is against a normal day for that market - over 100% means a bigger day than usual. Price at shows where price currently sits inside that range, 0% being today's low and 100% today's high. They are separate measures: a market can have a large day and sit anywhere within it.")
ds3_p1  = input.symbol("OANDA:EURUSD", "Pair 1", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_p2  = input.symbol("OANDA:GBPUSD", "Pair 2", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_p3  = input.symbol("OANDA:USDJPY", "Pair 3", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_p4  = input.symbol("OANDA:AUDUSD", "Pair 4", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_p5  = input.symbol("OANDA:XAUUSD", "Pair 5", group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_len = input.int(14, "Pair ATR length", minval = 1, group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_avg = input.int(20, "Normal day averaged over", minval = 2, group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_sz  = input.string("Tiny", "Pair table text size", options = ["Tiny", "Small", "Normal", "Large"], group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")
ds3_pos = input.string("Bottom right", "Pair table position", options = ["Top right", "Top left", "Bottom right", "Bottom left"], group = "Dessert · Pair metrics")

ds3_day(sym) =>
    request.security(sym, "D", [100.0 * (close - open) / open, ta.atr(ds3_len), (high - low), ta.sma(high - low, ds3_avg)[1], high, low, close], lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
ds3_wk(sym) =>
    request.security(sym, "W", 100.0 * (close - open) / open, lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

[ds3_c1, ds3_a1, ds3_r1, ds3_n1, ds3_h1, ds3_l1, ds3_x1] = ds3_day(ds3_p1)
[ds3_c2, ds3_a2, ds3_r2, ds3_n2, ds3_h2, ds3_l2, ds3_x2] = ds3_day(ds3_p2)
[ds3_c3, ds3_a3, ds3_r3, ds3_n3, ds3_h3, ds3_l3, ds3_x3] = ds3_day(ds3_p3)
[ds3_c4, ds3_a4, ds3_r4, ds3_n4, ds3_h4, ds3_l4, ds3_x4] = ds3_day(ds3_p4)
[ds3_c5, ds3_a5, ds3_r5, ds3_n5, ds3_h5, ds3_l5, ds3_x5] = ds3_day(ds3_p5)
ds3_w1 = ds3_wk(ds3_p1)
ds3_w2 = ds3_wk(ds3_p2)
ds3_w3 = ds3_wk(ds3_p3)
ds3_w4 = ds3_wk(ds3_p4)
ds3_w5 = ds3_wk(ds3_p5)

ds3_size  = ds3_sz == "Tiny" ? size.tiny : ds3_sz == "Small" ? size.small : ds3_sz == "Normal" ? size.normal : size.large
ds3_where = ds3_pos == "Top right" ? position.top_right : ds3_pos == "Top left" ? position.top_left : ds3_pos == "Bottom right" ? position.bottom_right : position.bottom_left

ds3_clean(sym) =>
    ds3_i = str.pos(sym, ":")
    na(ds3_i) ? sym : str.substring(sym, ds3_i + 1)
ds3_sign(v) =>
    (v >= 0 ? "+" : "") + str.tostring(v, "#.##") + "%"
ds3_pcol(v) =>
    v >= 0 ? #c9a84c : #d27050

var table ds3_t = table.new(ds3_where, 6, 6, border_width = 0)
ds3_head(c, txt) =>
    table.cell(ds3_t, c, 0, txt, text_color = #6b7280, text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
ds3_row(r, sym, chg, wk, atr, rng, nrm, hi, lo, cl) =>
    ds3_used = nrm > 0 ? 100.0 * rng / nrm : 0.0
    ds3_inr  = (hi - lo) > 0 ? 100.0 * (cl - lo) / (hi - lo) : 0.0
    table.cell(ds3_t, 0, r, ds3_clean(sym),                       text_color = #f2f0ea, text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds3_t, 1, r, ds3_sign(chg),                        text_color = ds3_pcol(chg), text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds3_t, 2, r, ds3_sign(wk),                         text_color = ds3_pcol(wk),  text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds3_t, 3, r, str.tostring(atr, format.mintick),    text_color = #9aa0a6, text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds3_t, 4, r, str.tostring(ds3_used, "#") + "%",    text_color = ds3_used > 110 ? #d27050 : ds3_used < 60 ? #9aa0a6 : #00abff, text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)
    table.cell(ds3_t, 5, r, str.tostring(ds3_inr, "#") + "%",     text_color = #f2f0ea, text_size = ds3_size, bgcolor = #0a0b0d)

if ds3_on and barstate.islast
    ds3_head(0, "PAIR")
    ds3_head(1, "DAY")
    ds3_head(2, "WEEK")
    ds3_head(3, "ATR")
    ds3_head(4, "DAY SIZE")
    ds3_head(5, "PRICE AT")
    ds3_row(1, ds3_p1, ds3_c1, ds3_w1, ds3_a1, ds3_r1, ds3_n1, ds3_h1, ds3_l1, ds3_x1)
    ds3_row(2, ds3_p2, ds3_c2, ds3_w2, ds3_a2, ds3_r2, ds3_n2, ds3_h2, ds3_l2, ds3_x2)
    ds3_row(3, ds3_p3, ds3_c3, ds3_w3, ds3_a3, ds3_r3, ds3_n3, ds3_h3, ds3_l3, ds3_x3)
    ds3_row(4, ds3_p4, ds3_c4, ds3_w4, ds3_a4, ds3_r4, ds3_n4, ds3_h4, ds3_l4, ds3_x4)
    ds3_row(5, ds3_p5, ds3_c5, ds3_w5, ds3_a5, ds3_r5, ds3_n5, ds3_h5, ds3_l5, ds3_x5)
